content: Cobicistat interacts with various drugs by influencing the hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism, leading to either increased or decreased drug levels and effects. Below are the specific interactions and recommendations for managing these interactions: 1. Cobicistat and Antibiotics (e.g., Atazanavir, Darunavir): Cobicistat increases the levels of these drugs. Consider alternative antibiotics or avoid coadministration. 2. Cobicistat and Flutamide: Cobicistat raises flutamide levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 3. Cobicistat and Fosaprepitant: Cobicistat increases fosaprepitant levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 4. Fosphenytoin and Cobicistat: Fosphenytoin decreases cobicistat levels. This combination is contraindicated. 5. Cobicistat and Futibatinib: Cobicistat increases futibatinib levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Co-administration with dual P-gp and strong CYP3A inhibitors may increase futibatinib toxicity. 6. Cobicistat and Gilteritinib: Cobicistat raises gilteritinib levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If unavoidable, monitor for adverse effects and adjust gilteritinib dosage as needed. 7. Cobicistat and Glasdegib: Cobicistat increases glasdegib levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Monitor for QTc prolongation and other adverse effects if coadministration is necessary. 8. Cobicistat and Guanfacine: Cobicistat raises guanfacine levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 9. Cobicistat and Ibrutinib: Cobicistat increases ibrutinib levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 10. Cobicistat and Idelalisib: Both drugs increase each other's levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 11. Indinavir and Cobicistat: Indinavir increases cobicistat levels. This combination is contraindicated. 12. Cobicistat and Infigratinib: Cobicistat raises infigratinib levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 13. Cobicistat and Itraconazole: Itraconazole increases cobicistat levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 14. Cobicistat and Ivosidenib: Cobicistat increases ivosidenib levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If coadministration is unavoidable, reduce the ivosidenib dose to 250 mg daily. 15. Cobicistat and Ixabepilone: Cobicistat raises ixabepilone levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 16. Cobicistat and Ketoconazole: Ketoconazole increases cobicistat levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 17. Cobicistat and Lapatinib: Cobicistat increases lapatinib levels. If coadministration is unavoidable, adjust the lapatinib dose to 500 mg daily. 18. Cobicistat and Larotrectinib: Cobicistat raises larotrectinib levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 19. Cobicistat and Lefamulin: Cobicistat increases lefamulin levels. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A inhibitors. 20. Cobicistat and Lemborexant: Cobicistat raises lemborexant levels. Avoid coadministration with moderate or strong CYP3A inhibitors. 21. Cobicistat and Leniolisib: Cobicistat increases leniolisib levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 22. Cobicistat and Levomilnacipran: Cobicistat raises levomilnacipran levels. Do not exceed 80 mg daily if coadministration is necessary. 23. Cobicistat and Levonorgestrel (Intrauterine): Cobicistat increases levonorgestrel levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 24. Cobicistat and Lomitapide: Cobicistat raises lomitapide levels. This combination is contraindicated. 25. Cobicistat and Lorlatinib: Cobicistat increases lorlatinib levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 26. Cobicistat and Lurbinectedin: Cobicistat raises lurbinectedin levels. If coadministration is unavoidable, reduce the lurbinectedin dose by 50%. 27. Cobicistat and Mefloquine: Cobicistat increases mefloquine levels, potentially increasing toxicity. Avoid coadministration during and for 15 weeks after discontinuing mefloquine. 28. Cobicistat and Midazolam (Intranasal): Cobicistat raises midazolam levels, potentially prolonging sedation. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 29. Cobicistat and Midostaurin: Cobicistat increases midostaurin levels. Monitor for adverse reactions, especially during the first week of treatment. 30. Mitotane and Cobicistat: Mitotane decreases cobicistat levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 31. Cobicistat and Modafinil: Cobicistat raises modafinil levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 32. Nafcillin and Cobicistat: Nafcillin decreases cobicistat levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 33. Cobicistat and Neratini: Cobicistat increases neratinib levels. Avoid coadministration with strong or moderate CYP3A inhibitors. 34. Nevirapine and Cobicistat: Nevirapine decreases cobicistat levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 35. Cobicistat and Nicardipine: Cobicistat raises nicardipine levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 36. Cobicistat and Nimodipine: Cobicistat increases nimodipine levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 37. Cobicistat and Niragacestat: Cobicistat raises niragacestat levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 38. Cobicistat and Nisoldipine: Cobicistat increases nisoldipine levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 39. Cobicistat and Olaparib: Cobicistat raises olaparib levels. If coadministration is unavoidable, reduce the olaparib dose to 150 mg (capsule) or 100 mg (tablet) twice daily. 40. Cobicistat and Omaveloxolone: Cobicistat increases omaveloxolone levels. Reduce the dose to 50 mg daily if coadministration is unavoidable. 41. Cobicistat and Ombitasvir/Paritaprevir/Ritonavir: This combination is contraindicated. 42. Cobicistat and Osimertinib: Cobicistat raises osimertinib levels. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A inhibitors. 43. Oxcarbazepine and Cobicistat: Oxcarbazepine decreases cobicistat levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 44. Cobicistat and Ozanimod: Cobicistat increases ozanimod levels, potentially increasing adverse reactions. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 45. Cobicistat and Palbociclib: Cobicistat raises palbociclib levels. If coadministration is unavoidable, reduce the palbociclib dose to 75 mg daily. 46. Cobicistat and Pexidartinib: Cobicistat increases pexidartinib levels. Reduce the dose if coadministration is unavoidable. 47. Phenobarbital and Cobicistat: Phenobarbital decreases cobicistat levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 48. Cobicistat and Pimavanserin: Cobicistat raises pimavanserin levels. Reduce the dose to 17 mg daily if coadministered. 49. Cobicistat and Ponatinib: Cobicistat increases ponatinib levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 50. Cobicistat and Posaconazole: Posaconazole increases cobicistat levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 51. Cobicistat and Pralsetinib: Cobicistat raises pralsetinib levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 52. Primidone and Cobicistat: Primidone decreases cobicistat levels. This combination is contraindicated. 53. Cobicistat and Progesterone (Intravaginal Gel, Micronized, Natural): Cobicistat increases progesterone levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 54. Cobicistat and Quetiapine: Cobicistat raises quetiapine levels. Reduce the quetiapine dose to one-sixth of the current dose if coadministration is necessary. 55. Cobicistat and Repotrectinib: Cobicistat increases repotrectinib levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 56. Cobicistat and Resmetirom: Cobicistat increases resmetirom levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 57. Cobicistat and Rivaroxaban: Cobicistat raises rivaroxaban levels, increasing bleeding risk. Avoid coadministration. 58. Cobicistat and Ruxolitinib (Topical): Cobicistat increases ruxolitinib levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 59. Cobicistat and Salmeterol: Cobicistat raises salmeterol levels, increasing cardiovascular risks. Avoid coadministration. 60. Cobicistat and Saxagliptin: Cobicistat increases saxagliptin levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 61. Cobicistat and Selumetinib: Cobicistat raises selumetinib levels. Reduce the selumetinib dose if coadministration is unavoidable. 62. Cobicistat and Siponimod: Cobicistat increases siponimod levels. Avoid coadministration with moderate or strong CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 inhibitors. 63. Cobicistat and Solifenacin: Cobicistat raises solifenacin levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 64. Cobicistat and Sonidegib: Cobicistat increases sonidegib levels. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 65. Cobicistat and Sparsentan: Cobicistat raises sparsentan levels. Interrupt sparsentan treatment if coadministration is unavoidable. 66. Cobicistat and Sunitinib: Cobicistat increases sunitinib levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 67. Cobicistat and Suvorexant: Cobicistat raises suvorexant levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 68. Cobicistat and Tadalafil: Cobicistat increases tadalafil levels. Adjust the tadalafil dose for pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) or erectile dysfunction (ED) as needed. 69. Cobicistat and Talazoparib: Cobicistat increases talazoparib levels. Monitor for adverse reactions if coadministration is unavoidable. 70. Cobicistat and Tamoxifen: Cobicistat decreases tamoxifen effects. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 71. Cobicistat and Tamsulosin: Cobicistat raises tamsulosin levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 72. Cobicistat and Tazemetostat: Cobicistat increases tazemetostat levels. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 73. Cobicistat and Teniposide: Cobicistat raises teniposide levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 74. Cobicistat and Ticagrelor: Cobicistat increases ticagrelor levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 75. Tipranavir and Cobicistat: Tipranavir increases cobicistat levels. This combination is contraindicated. 76. Cobicistat and Tofacitinib: Cobicistat raises tofacitinib levels. Reduce the tofacitinib dose to 5 mg daily if coadministered. 77. Cobicistat and Tolterodine: Cobicistat increases tolterodine levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 78. Cobicistat and Tolvaptan: Cobicistat raises tolvaptan levels. This combination is contraindicated. 79. Cobicistat and Topotecan: Cobicistat increases topotecan levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 80. Cobicistat and Toremifene: Cobicistat raises toremifene levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 81. Cobicistat and Trabectedin: Cobicistat increases trabectedin levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 82. Cobicistat and Trazodone: Cobicistat raises trazodone levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 83. Cobicistat and Tucatinib: Cobicistat increases tucatinib levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 84. Cobicistat and Valbenazine: Cobicistat raises valbenazine levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 85. Cobicistat and Vemurafenib: Cobicistat increases vemurafenib levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 86. Cobicistat and Vilanterol/Fluticasone Furoate (Inhaled): Cobicistat raises these drug levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 87. Cobicistat and Vilazodone: Cobicistat increases vilazodone levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 88. Cobicistat and Vincristine (Liposomal): Cobicistat raises vincristine levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 89. Cobicistat and Vorapaxar: Cobicistat increases vorapaxar levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 90. Cobicistat and Zolpidem: Cobicistat raises zolpidem levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 91. Cobicistat and Abemaciclib: Cobicistat increases abemaciclib levels. Reduce the abemaciclib dose and monitor closely. 92. Cobicistat and Alfentanil: Cobicistat raises alfentanil levels. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 93. Cobicistat and Amiodarone: Cobicistat increases amiodarone levels. Use caution and monitor closely. These interactions highlight the importance of careful monitoring and dose adjustments when cobicistat is coadministered with other medications.
